    01What you need

    Equipment needed

    1. 01

      OCCTA Broadband

      An active OCCTA broadband connection is required for Digital Home Phone.

    2. 02

      OCCTA Router

      Use your own compatible router or get one from us with your broadband order — Digital Voice needs a router with a phone port.

    3. 03

      Standard Home Phone

      Any standard home phone handset. Most existing phones work by plugging directly into the router.

    02Please read
    Important: Power Cuts & Emergency Calls
    Digital Voice needs power and broadband to work. Emergency calls (999/112) may not work during a power cut or broadband outage. We recommend keeping a mobile phone for emergencies, and please tell us if anyone in the household relies on the phone in an emergency so we can discuss back-up options.
